previousCoordinate.reasonReplaced: Legacy-punktet lå sørøst for den utsprengte slusekanalen og manglet kontrakt mot selve slusekammeret.

identity.resolvedIdentity: Strømsfoss sluse, énkammeranlegget fra 1860 mellom Aremarksjøen og Øymarksjøen.
identity.identityProblem: Strømsfoss er både landsby, foss, bru, mølle- og handelssted, slusemiljø og målestasjonssted. Canonical må identifisere slusekanalen og kammeret, ikke det bredere tettstedet.
identity.splitReason: Slusen er ett sammenhengende anlegg. Brua, fossen, mølla, slusemesterboligen, landhandleriet, bryggene og målestasjonen er relaterte, men separate komponenter.

evidence.finding: Identifies Strømsfoss locks at 59.3005, 11.6601, with one chamber, two gates, two metres of lift and construction in 1857–1860.
evidence.reason: Direct named lock coordinate and detailed physical description.

evidence.finding: Identifies a lock at Strømsfoss in the north end of Aremarksjøen and assigns high national value to Haldenkanalen as technical heritage.
Documents one chamber, two gates, two metres of lift, construction from 1857 to 1860, the blasted channel and current guest-berth and service context.
evidence.reason: Supports physical configuration and current visitor use.

evidence.finding: States that Strømsfoss and Ørje locks were built in 1860 and remain part of the living canal heritage.
evidence.reason: Independent municipal chronology and continuing-use control.

evidence.finding: Identifies Strømsfoss locks between Aremarksjøen and Øymarksjøen and confirms the two-metre lift.
evidence.reason: Current regional place and lock control.

evidence.finding: A 2023 photograph of the lock has camera location 59.300670, 11.660200, approximately 20 metres from the applied point.
evidence.reason: Independent visual-location control inside the same lock environment.

evidence.finding: Places the road bridge at approximately 59.30152, 11.65972 north of the lock.
evidence.reason: Prevents the nearby bridge from being mistaken for lock geometry.

evidence.finding: Q7626074 identifies the settlement, not the lock installation.
evidence.reason: Rejected as canonical because it represents the village.

evidence.finding: Documents the manual precipitation station established in 1883 beside the locks and its long measurement continuity.
evidence.reason: Important adjacent component but not the lock chamber itself.

evidence.finding: The legacy point is approximately 342.2 metres south-east of the named lock coordinate.
evidence.reason: Rejected because it does not identify the lock channel or chamber.

sourceObjectCandidates.rejectionReason: Camera location supports the same site but is not a canonical lock entity.

rawEvidence.description: Persisted lock coordinate, physical configuration, canal chronology, current-use context and separation from settlement, bridge, waterfall and weather station.

decision.nextAction: Applied the named single-chamber lock coordinate, retained 1860 as opening year and separated the lock from village, bridge, waterfall, mill and measurement-station objects. Continue with moss_mollebyen_industri.

notes: The coordinate moves approximately 342 metres north-northwest.
The single lock chamber and blasted channel are the canonical object.
The bridge, waterfall, mill, lockmaster environment and weather station are separate components.
The radius is not a lock, canal, quay, property, safety, heritage or access boundary.
